answer: Standing is an ocean that only stays deep when the work beneath it endures: each piece of work is re-checked many epochs later, and only work that strangers still use counts — a quill records standing only when old work proves durable, and a fable of trust only rings true when its foundations hold. A farm of a thousand fakes builds on sand: its cheap work is useless within an epoch, so each fake must produce work that strangers still need long after — and one piece of work that rots drains the ocean beneath it.
